assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddServerSideSessions() on the IdentityServer builder
AddOperationalStore is configured with EnableTokenCleanup set to true
assertions.rationale: options.EnableTokenCleanup = true is set in AddOperationalStore.

assertions.assertion: AddOperationalStore options set RemoveConsumedTokens to true
AddServerSideSessions is called before or alongside AddOperationalStore, not after it without the operational store
assertions.rationale: AddServerSideSessions() is placed after AddOperationalStore, but within the same builder chain and with the operational store present, so it does not hit the prohibited case of enabling sessions without an operational store; the ideal ordering would place it before.
